title: security: RBAC v2 + audit hardening for KMS region-pinning and data residency
author: Ava Martinez
release_notes: Enforce KMS region pinning at RBAC v2 evaluation time, strengthen audit logging for KMS key usage, add migration to surface existing non-compliant keys, and ship new policy controls for data residency. No user-facing API changes; opt-in via feature flag for 2-week canary.
description: Context: This PR hardens RBAC v2 policy evaluation and audit trails for KMS-driven data residency and region-pinning controls. Motivation: customers operating in regulated regions need deterministic enforcement and complete auditability when users bind or reference customer-managed keys across regions. What this changes: 1) RBAC v2 evaluator now consults KMS residency metadata during allow/deny decisions for Create/Update of resources that reference external keys; policy predicates added: kms.region == resource.region and kms.residency == required_residency. 2) Audit logger enhancements capture key fingerprint, key ARN, resolved region, policy decision context, and KMS reply codes for every encrypted resource write. 3) Migration: a background job and SQL migration to surface resources referencing out-of-region keys into an administrative review queue. 4) New integration and e2e tests covering cross-account and cross-region key scenarios. 5) Docs and console: admin UX for KMS region pinning and remediation steps. Checklist: - [x] RBAC v2 policy predicates and evaluator unit tests - [x] Audit schema addition and retention-offer doc updates - [x] Migration job and admin queue implementation - [x] E2E tests simulating cross-region KMS references - [x] Helm chart and config flag support (featureFlag.kmsRegionPinning) - [x] Security review and threat modeling notes attached Implementation notes: RBAC changes are localized to pkg/rbac/v2/enforcer (introduced EnforceKMSRegionPinning hook) and pkg/policy/predicate_kms.go. Audit changes are in internal/audit/logger_kms.go with schema version bump audit.v4. Migration adds deploy/migrations/2026_02_25_kms_region_pin.sql and a long-running job under cmd/admin/kyc_migrations that enqueues non-compliant resources. Config: helm/values.yaml adds featureFlag.kmsRegionPinning and audit.retentionDays override. Feature rollout: gated behind featureFlag.kmsRegionPinning. We will enable in a 2-week canary on dedicated clusters in us-west-2, then roll globally. Backwards compatibility: when flag is off, behavior unchanged; audit entries still include new fields (storage-safe) only when enabled. Testing: local unit tests + CI integration against mocked KMS; e2e run against a dedicated cluster; manual smoke tests on a staging tenant. Migration/rescue: added admin command "redwood admin kms-resurface" to re-evaluate resources after fixes. Related: ENG-4921 tracks rollout, SEC-210 contains threat model. Commits: listed below. Merge: squash merge after all approvals.
